incidents.name: PegaBall
incidents.notes: buyGamesFrom self-funds purchases from the proxy balance instead of requiring msg.value, letting a vendor drain vendor/referrer cuts.

sources.ref: deployment-basis recheck: the recorded victim is the logic contract PegaBallV1Implementation, not a proxy - callTracer shows the proxy 0xb8fcabf7bd88a2489fafbafa5f9a05a0e068cb5e DELEGATECALLing into it (buyGamesFrom 0xbb020d29), and the victim itself makes no delegatecall (its two delegatecall sites are OpenZeppelin's ERC1967 _upgradeToAndCall helpers). Its runtime is byte-identical at the creation block 19003242 and the incident block 22626978, and the proxy's EIP-1967 slot has pointed at it since the proxy's creation in that same block 19003242, unchanged to the incident. Deployment is exact; 506.7 days.

onchain review: victim re-anchored from implementation 0x29003DD6B9970AD658314fFFB61E42F352C41630 to the proxy the protocol runs at, 0xb8fcabf7bd88a2489fafbafa5f9a05a0e068cb5e, which holds that implementation in its EIP-1967 slot and emits the exploit transaction's logs while the implementation emits none; age measured from when the proxy started running the implementation rather than from the implementation's own deployment (43775580s -> 43775580s)
